A chatbot that answers customers from your own content, captures leads and hands over to your team.

Overview

An AI assistant for your website and WhatsApp that answers questions using only your approved content, collects enquiries, books appointments and passes anything complicated to a person. It replies at any hour, in English and Tamil, and you see every conversation.

Ideal for

  • Businesses that get the same questions all day
  • Clinics, schools, showrooms and service firms that miss after-hours enquiries
  • Online stores that want faster order and delivery answers
